title: Baselines: intrinsic strength and a single flaw
caption: The pristine zigzag sheet reaches 38.8 N/m and fails in one avalanche; a 20 Å crack halves the strength (18.5 N/m) and fails by crack propagation at 9% strain. Screened REBO2, athermal quasi-static uniaxial tension along x; colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV); red rings: atoms that have lost a bond; frames between stored quasi-static states are interpolated. All statements are model results.
slow_motion: 3x within ±0.0025 strain of first damage, peak load and major propagation
text_in_movie: chart axis labels and colour-bar numbers only
colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV), inferno colour map truncated at 0.9
chart: 2D stress (N/m) against engineering strain, one curve per panel in the panel's frame colour, moving marker at the current state
